-- ============================================================
-- ONE-TIME SETUP — run once, in this exact order.
-- Do not need to rerun this after it succeeds, same principle
-- as bronze/silver/gold_one_time_job notebooks in Databricks.
-- ============================================================

-- 1. Create the serving database
CREATE DATABASE gold_serving;
-- (after this runs, switch "Use database" dropdown to gold_serving
--  before running everything below)

-- 2. Master key — required before any credential can be stored
CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = '201530291@Synapse';

-- 3. Explicit managed-identity credential — forces Synapse to
--    authenticate as the WORKSPACE's identity, not the calling
--    user (Azure AD pass-through would otherwise be the default)
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL synapse_msi_credential
WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';

-- 4. External data source — root of the gold container, using
--    the credential above
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE gold_lake
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'abfss://gold@azuresales.dfs.core.windows.net/',
    CREDENTIAL = synapse_msi_credential
);

-- 5. Reusable file format object — every external table below
--    references this by name, only needs to be created once
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT delta_format
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELTA
);
